stack.construction: AQS-DUTY-068 (docs-authority/sizing/BMED_STACK.md) / A-M-170: 300 x 300 frames, 0.8 mm PE mesh spacers, one bipolar and two monopolar membranes per triplet, Ti/MMO anode and 316L/Ni cathode end plates, tie-rod clamped; the same construction AQS-TST-006 (AQS-TST-006 section 2) builds the bench apparatus to
stack.allocation_note: the sizing page books 421 triplets in 5 stacks of 85 plus 1 spare for the BMED pair; the node books no per-unit stack count, so the model draws the representative stack module (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)
stack.material_note: frames drawn PVC-U per duty section 3 (no metal wetted part); the sizing page construction names PP frames - PVC-U drawn, PP named (hold, W12); electrode end plates are the A-M-170 electrochemical hardware (Ti/MMO, 316L/Ni)

a_cell.basis: A-CELL: plate count, plate size, pitch and active area per the AQS-DUTY-068 / A-M-170/171 construction; duty section 2 carries no plate row, so the match is against the sizing construction, not the duty sheet (hold, W12); POWER.md states no bus bar for this class, so the bus-bar criterion has nothing to match
a_cell.voltage_note: the pair's stack power is booked on BMED_ACID (this unit's duty section 9: 'Stack power is booked on BMED_ACID'); the sizing design voltage is the 1.67 V pilot class, and AQS-TST-006 section 5 holds the measured verification band - figures reported, not recomputed here

skid.tray: PVC-U drip tray, floor 20 + curb 60 x 10 (duty section 3: PVC-U wetted; CA 0 mm, AQS-STD-001 polymer rule)
skid.hold_down: PVC-U beam z 330..350 on four posts over the stack; the M2 style-build top rails are not carried (layout choice, WORK_ORDER W12)
